morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，严格说属于附着语素，并非普通派生后缀；此处按字段归入 suffix。连接时词根不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi ڤريقسا 只对应 periksa；完整形式应加上 ڽ，写作 ڤريقساڽ。输入未提供分音节；按构成可分为 pe.rik.sa.nya。periksa 是完整词根，不拆成 per- + iksa。

senses.zh_definition: 检查、查验或诊察他、她或前文所指的对象；具体指代须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Examine or check him, her, or the previously mentioned object, especially in an instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Periksa orang atau perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya untuk mengetahui keadaannya.
senses.nuances: 这是 periksa 与 -nya 的规范组合分析，不表示已核实 periksanya 是 DBP 独立词条；马来文释义为组合释义。祈使句可用 Periksanya dahulu；正式主动陈述句通常用 memeriksanya，例如 Doktor akan memeriksanya。IPA 为按构词推定的宽式标音。词义依据：[DBP：periksa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=periksa)；附着代词依据：[DBP：-nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tatabahasa+nya)。

collocations.en: check him, her, or it first
examine him, her, or it carefully

senses.zh_definition: 其调查、查究或审察；见于旧式书面语，具体含义取决于上下文。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its inquiry or investigation, in older literary usage.
senses.ms_definition: Penyelidikan atau siasatan yang berkaitan dengan pihak yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 词根 periksa 也有名词性的“调查、查究”义，因此 -nya 可表所属。孤立词形不足以判定它一定是动词。此义的现代常用表达是 pemeriksaannya 或 penyiasatannya；以下为释义性组合，不视为已核实的现代高频搭配。词根依据：[DBP：periksa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=periksa)。

collocations.en: his or her inquiries and investigation
the findings of his or her investigation

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pesakit itu masih demam; sila periksanya semula sebelum membenarkannya pulang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该患者仍在发烧；请再次为他检查，再决定是否准许他离院。
dual_scenarios.en: The patient still has a fever; please examine him again before allowing him to go home.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Adik masih demam. Tolong periksanya dulu, ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adik masih demam. Tolong periksanya dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 弟弟还在发烧，麻烦先帮他检查一下。
dual_scenarios.en: My little brother still has a fever. Please check him first.
spoken_features: ya 用来缓和请求语气。
periksanya 带有书面色彩；更随意的口语常说 periksa dia。

messages.speaker: Farah (患者家属)
messages.ms_spoken: Adik masih demam. Tolong periksanya dulu, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Adik masih demam. Tolong periksanya dahulu.
messages.zh: 弟弟还在发烧，麻烦先帮他检查一下。
messages.en: My little brother still has a fever. Please check him first.

messages.speaker: Dr. Amir (医生)
messages.ms_spoken: Baik, saya akan memeriksanya sekarang. Tunggu kat luar dulu, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Baik, saya akan memeriksanya sekarang. Sila tunggu di luar dahulu.
messages.zh: 好，我现在就给他检查。你先在外面等一下。
messages.en: All right, I'll examine him now. Please wait outside for a moment.

etymology.historical_story: Periksa ultimately comes from Sanskrit parīkṣā, meaning investigation or examination. Its initial per- belongs to the borrowed root rather than being a Malay prefix. Malay subsequently built forms such as memeriksa and pemeriksaan around it. Periksanya adds the attached pronoun -nya, whose reference must be recovered from the surrounding sentence. Source: [linguistic study of Malay affixes](https://brill.com/view/journals/bki/165/2-3/article-p291_4.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: periksa 是“检查”，-nya 把前文对象接回来：periksanya，就是“检查他／她／它”；先找对象，再定译法。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Periksanya! 可能显得命令意味较强。请求医生、同事或服务人员协助时，加 sila、tolong 或 boleh，例如 Boleh doktor periksa adik saya?
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 医疗、安检或调查语境中应明确检查对象，避免 -nya 指代不清。尊称对象可直接使用姓名或合适称谓；不能只凭这一词形推断性别。
